data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Oil Rises Again as Saudi East-West Pipeline Stays Shut
data.description:
Oil climbed for a second day after the Saudi Arabian East-West pipeline remained offline, according to Bloomberg.

The conduit, a workaround for Strait of Hormuz flows, was shut last week after attacks, and Saudi Aramco has not said when it may restart. Tyler Kendall reported on Bloomberg Television.

data.title: AI | Corient’s Daniel Pinto Dismisses Talk of an AI Slowdown
data.description: Talk of an AI slowdown is "more PR than substance" as US technology companies race to compete with one another and with China, according to Bloomberg. Daniel Pinto, EMEA chief executive officer at wealth manager Corient, made the comment in an interview with Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua on "The Pulse".

data.title: JPMorgan’s Misra Says Bond Selloff May Be Nearing Its End
data.description: Priya Misra, a portfolio manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, said the bond selloff may be nearing an end, but cautioned that several things still need to happen before investors step in, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: BNB Surpasses 720 USDT with a Narrowed 0.40% Decrease in 24 Hours
data.description: On Sep 15, 2026, 10:56 AM(UTC). According to Binance Market Data, BNB has crossed the 720 USDT benchmark and is now trading at 720.109985 USDT, with a narrowed narrowed 0.40% decrease in 24 hours.

data.title: Standard Chartered-Backed Anchorpoint Financial Launches TAP Programme
data.description:
Anchorpoint Financial, the licensed stablecoin issuer jointly backed by Standard Chartered, HKT and Animoca Brands, said on Tuesday it has launched the Tokenised Money Adoption Programme (TAP), an industry initiative focused on education, research and dialogue around tokenised money in Hong Kong.

PwC also signed a memorandum of understanding with Anchorpoint Financial and became the programme's first strategic partner, according to Ming Pao.

data.title: KKR Private Investment-Grade Deal Volume Doubles to $80 Billion This Year
data.description:
KKR & Co. doubled the amount of private investment-grade financing it structured this year to $80 billion, according to Bloomberg.

The increase reflects growing demand from companies seeking flexible borrowing options.

data.title: Barclays Reaffirms Buy Rating on Strategy, Sets $160 Target Price
data.description: Barclays Bank, which manages $2.3 trillion in assets, reaffirmed its buy rating on Bitcoin treasury company Strategy and set a $160 target price. According to Odaily, Barclays grouped MSTR with fintech giants such as Visa and Mastercard.

data.title: Japan Land Prices Rise For Fifth Straight Year
data.description:
According to Nikkei Asia, Japan's average land price rose for a fifth straight year, with the nationwide overall average up 1.5% in the 12 months to July 1, government data released on Tuesday showed. Commercial land prices climbed 2.9% on demand for shops and hotels, while residential land prices gained 1.0%.

The three largest metropolitan areas of Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya posted a 4.4% increase, while the rest of the country was flat at 0.4%, widening the gap between urban centers and regional areas. Among major cities outside the three metros, land-price growth slowed to 4.1% from 5.3% a year earlier. Furano in Hokkaido recorded the sharpest rise in residential land at 32.0%, and Hakuba in Nagano prefecture had the steepest increase in commercial land at 35.6%. The Meidi-ya Ginza commercial building site in Tokyo remained Japan's most expensive piece of real estate at 52.5 million yen per square meter for the 21st straight year.

data.title: South Korea and Egypt Advance Next Month's Summit, With Energy Supply Chains in Focus
data.description:
South Korea and Egypt are pushing to hold a summit next month, with cooperation on energy supply chains expected to be a core topic. According to Sina Finance, the agenda may also include the crude oil bypass transport network, whose importance has risen as Middle East tensions have worsened.

The two sides are discussing the schedule for high-level talks, including arrangements for an Egyptian leader's visit to South Korea next month. A South Korean government official said the two countries are continuing consultations on the summit, but added that the exact schedule has not yet been finalized.

If the summit takes place, it would be the first meeting since President Lee Jae-myung and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi met in November last year. At that meeting, the two sides agreed to continue negotiations on a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, or CEPA, and Egypt would become the first African country to sign the pact with South Korea.

At the time, President el-Sisi said he hoped South Korean petrochemical, auto, and shipbuilding companies would increase investment in the Suez Canal Economic Zone. Energy supply chains may become an added focus at this summit, as instability in the Middle East has raised uncertainty over existing crude oil transport routes and increased the strategic value of the Mediterranean crude oil bypass network based on the Suez Canal and the SUMED Pipeline.

data.title: China Steel Body Urges Mills to Cut Output and Inventories
data.description: China’s top iron and steel industry body has called on domestic mills to curb production and reduce inventories as oversupply and weak demand weigh on the market, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: STOCKS | Wall Street Expects Fed to Signal Hawkish Move This Week
data.description:
U.S. stocks have posted strong gains this year, driven by large-scale investment in AI infrastructure. According to Sina Finance, the S&P 500 is up 12% year to date, the Nasdaq Composite has risen 13%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average has gained 9%.

Wall Street expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates this week, which could begin a new tightening cycle. According to Sina Finance, the CME FedWatch Tool shows the most likely outcome for the FOMC meeting ending September 16 is a 25-basis-point rate hike, with an 87% probability that the federal funds target range will move from 3.5%-3.75% to 3.75%-4%.

data.title: Binance Launches Summer Camp With 10-Day Crypto Learning Journey and 10,000 USDC Rewards
data.description:
According to the announcement from Binance, Binance Summer Camp is a 10-day gamified learning program designed to make crypto education more interactive and accessible through daily lessons, quizzes, and themed missions. The activity period runs from 2026-09-15 08:00 (UTC) to 2026-09-25 08:00 (UTC). Participants who complete all 10 lessons and quizzes will unlock a personalized Graduation Certificate, while each daily challenge can also unlock a themed badge. The announcement says Graduation Certificates will be displayed on the Summer Camp Graduation Wall, where participants can view other graduates and their messages. In addition to the lessons, users can earn points by checking in, completing daily tasks, sharing Summer Camp content on Binance Square or X, and joining designated Binance community channels. Participants must collect at least 640 points to qualify for the Community Challenges Rewards described in the announcement.

Community rewards total 10,000 USDC in token vouchers, split evenly between the English and Chinese communities. For the English Community, the first 500 users to complete all surveys on Day 1, Day 4, and Day 10 across the listed Binance channels will share 5,000 USDC, equal to 10 USDC per user. For the Chinese Community, the first 500 users to complete the same survey requirements across the listed Chinese community channels will also share 5,000 USDC, equal to 10 USDC per user. Binance said participants must log in to their Binance account, complete identity verification (KYC), and follow the instructions shared on the relevant community channels. The announcement also states that rewards will be distributed before 2026-09-30, and token vouchers will be redeemable through Profile > Rewards Hub with a 30-day validity period from the day of distribution.

data.title: Hu'an Securities Issues 1 Billion Yuan Short-Term Financing Bill at 1.51%
data.description: Hu'an Securities said its 2026 fifth short-term financing bill, 26 Hu'an Securities CP005, was completed on September 14, 2026, with both planned and actual issuance size at 1 billion yuan, according to Jiemian News. The bill has a term of 192 days, was issued on September 11, 2026, began accruing interest on September 14, 2026, and will mature on March 25, 2027. The coupon rate is 1.51%, and the issue price was 100 yuan per bond. The related documents have been posted on China Money and Shanghai Clearing House websites.

data.title: Huayou Cobalt Issues 1 Billion Yuan Green Technology Innovation Bond at 2.20%
data.description:
Huayou Cobalt said on September 15, 2026 that it has completed the issuance of its 11th 2026 green technology innovation bond, with a size of 1 billion yuan, a two-year tenor and a coupon rate of 2.20%, according to Jiemian News. The bond, named 26 Huayou Cobalt GN011 (Sci-Tech Innovation Bond), was publicly issued in China's interbank bond market through book-building and centralized allocation.

China CITIC Bank, China Merchants Bank, SPD Bank, Bank of China, Industrial Bank, BOCI Securities and Bohai Bank acted as lead underwriters. Proceeds will be used to replace spending made by a subsidiary within the past three months on recycling waste power batteries and dismantled materials, as well as raw-material purchases for a battery-grade lithium salt production project. Huayou Cobalt also said its 2025 annual shareholders' meeting approved a proposal for the company and its subsidiaries to issue non-financial corporate debt financing instruments in 2026, including public and private placements.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Pound Volatility Signals Complacency Ahead of UK Budget
data.description:
A measure of UK pound volatility is flashing warning signs that markets may be too complacent ahead of Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s first Budget, according to Bloomberg.

The source did not provide additional details on the volatility measure or the Budget.

data.title: Grab to Acquire Majority of Atome Financial for $1.49 Billion
data.description:
Grab Holdings Ltd. agreed to buy a majority stake in Singapore-based buy-now-pay-later platform Atome Financial for $1.49 billion, according to Bloomberg.

The deal is part of Grab's push to expand financial services as it builds a new growth pillar.

data.title: Bessent’s Growth Plan for US Debt Faces Credibility Doubts
data.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has argued that faster economic growth can ease concerns about the U.S. fiscal outlook, a theme of his recent G20 leadership, according to Bloomberg. History suggests that approach may not be enough to resolve worries about troubling debt trajectories.

data.title: ManpowerGroup Hong Kong Says Hiring Outlook Turns Positive For Fourth Quarter
data.description:
ManpowerGroup Hong Kong said its Employment Outlook Survey showed local employers expect hiring sentiment to turn more positive in the fourth quarter, with overall recruitment intentions recovering, according to Ming Pao.

Among 603 employers surveyed, 30% expect to add staff in the next three months, 16% plan to reduce headcount, and 54% do not plan to change current staffing levels next quarter. The seasonally adjusted employment outlook index for next quarter was +14%, up 23 percentage points from the previous quarter, but 15 percentage points below the global average.

data.title: Stack BTC Proposes Up to £12 Million Acquisition of Direct Bullion
data.description: Stack BTC has proposed acquiring precious metals dealer Direct Bullion for up to 12 million pounds ($16 million). According to NS3.AI, the non-binding deal includes 3 million pounds in cash and about £4 million in shares at completion. The proposal remains subject to due diligence, definitive agreements, and approvals.

data.title: STOCKS | Tencent Buys Back 229,000 Shares for About HK$101 Million
data.description:
Tencent Holdings (00700) said it repurchased about 229,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange today at HK$428 to HK$445.8 each, for a total of about HK$101 million, according to ETNet.

The company said cumulative repurchases under the mandate have reached about 45.5457 million shares, representing 0.49951% of its share capital.
